query: SELECT * FROM order_line WHERE w_id BETWEEN 129 AND 130 ORDER BY w_id,d_id,o_id,number LIMIT 20 OFFSET 2;
method: Two CLI executions per build in one fresh process, one worker, WAL enabled with WAL fsync disabled. First sample has a fresh engine block cache; second repeats the query. Operating-system caches are not reset. Query execution timings exclude CLI output. Diagnostic local measurements, not a throughput benchmark.

full_dataset_validation.method: The equal-data TPC-C snapshot verifier was rerun with w_id BETWEEN bounds for composite tables after the fix. Every column of every row was compared with the independently saved source snapshot.
